title: Mapping the fitness landscapes of metastasizing cancers
summary: It is of fundamental importance to understand what enables cancer cells to form metastases and become resistant to therapies. In this project, we aim to understand how metastases adapt to the target tissue. For this purpose, we use a technology that allows us to determine which gene is active at which location within the tumor. In this way, we aim to understand how cancer cells adapt during the formation of metastases.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of bronchus and lung

interventions.name: We will identify driver alterations in metastases. Using spatial transcriptomics from primary tumors and metastases, we will map transcriptomic and genomic changes that have newly arisen in the metastases. By analyzing the spatial transcriptomic data, we will identify genes that increase the fitness

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Carcinoma of the colon or lung or pancras with metastases
Exclusion criteria:
younger than 18 years, no consent for research use of the remaining tissue
